observations.scientific_operator: Inner products/reductions over actual half inputs with distinct arithmetic policies. The selected source case visits three custom modes at five grid sizes and two vendor paths for each of two fixtures. Source policies, policy fidelity and mathematical dot-product accuracy are separate questions.
observations.precision_layout: f16sp_acc explicitly converts half input pairs to T and uses fma in that T accumulator; factories supply Val(Float16) or Val(Float32). The same dot_tree family can therefore represent distinct arithmetic policies. cuBLAS/CUB paths remain vendor operations, and no guessed demangled identity or tensor-instruction equivalence is assigned.
observations.timing_boundary: execute resets custom output inside its timed callback; three repeats for each mode/grid are between timer start and completion fence. Vendor calls also occur inside execute. Readback and guard/oracle checking follow elapsed timing. Warmup uses the same execute paths, so saved family matches do not establish sample phase.

observations.scientific_operator: The full source pipeline performs an image pyramid, integral/squared-integral images, normalized Haar rectangle features, a 25-stage cascade, sliding-window classification and rectangle grouping. The selected GPU family materializes rectangle corner addresses; its presence does not imply the cascade classifier executes on the GPU.
observations.precision_layout: address_body! produces UInt64 host-address values from Int32 rectangle coordinates and image width, with four-byte offsets and a zero-address sentinel for absent third rectangles. Returned addresses are checked/normalized and dereferenced against host integral-image storage; physical address identity is process-specific. Host classification uses source integer/UInt32 normalization and Float32 pyramid/grouping arithmetic.
observations.timing_boundary: Timer wraps allocation-inclusive detect/invoke plus synchronization; input copies, pointer materialization, host classification and grouping lie in that declared pipeline. A separate detect/invoke replay after elapsed timing records detailed traces. It must remain distinct from source-family membership and measured sample phase.

observations.scientific_operator: Direct positive-exponential complex Fourier accumulation from complex mu values and k coordinates into sample positions, preserving each initial output and source chunk order. This is an imaging/spectral operator rather than a complete reconstruction workflow.
observations.precision_layout: cmpfhd uses Float32 coordinates, Float32(2pi), fast sin/cos and ordered Float32 real/imag updates. The actual source LLVM AS4 symbol holds 12288 Float32 components (49152 bytes), corresponding to chunks of up to4096 k triples. No broad tensor, instruction mix, causal bottleneck or calibrated imaging-quality claim follows from this source review.
observations.timing_boundary: Native run uploads each constant-memory chunk then calls cmpfhd; Julia run mirrors upload_constant then the explicitly factory-bound callback. Both uploads and compute lie inside run timer, while factory compilation/PTX dump/symbol acquisition, resets and final constant/readback checks occur outside. Warmup runs the same chunk pipeline.
